preset__agent-presets__tests__shipped-ro.note: The dsh-mobile host intentionally ships its own `mobile` preset (runtime/dsh/presets-mobile, synthesized into the generated probe seed); the vendored roster assertion enumerates exactly the upstream four (cordis/minimal/ptc/standard) and cannot pass on this host. qjs 5/1 vs node 6/0 — a real host-vs-upstream-contract finding, kept as a documented delta.

subprocess__subprocess-local__tests__spa.note: Structural both-legs red in kind: the inlined spawnRunnerInvocation branches on import.meta.url ending .ts, and a single-file transpile pins it to the built-entry limb, so the assertion's source-form tsx/esm URL (registry-served, double-encoded %252F) can never appear. Upstream is green only inside its monorepo layout.

deliverables__workspace-changes__tests__.note: Two facets. (1) The qjs leg pins HOME under the profile container (/tmp/dsh-runtime-smoke.*) while the vendored plugin hardcodes /tmp as its temporary root — out-of-repo $HOME captures fail the vendored isTemporaryPath rule and are legitimately excluded (two it-blocks). (2) os.tmpdir() deliberately pins the profile container: honoring the spec's TMPDIR env rewrite (real node's POSIX contract) would let the shell's TMPDIR move every tmp write out of the fs sandbox — a frozen host-contract refusal, not a bug. node 16/0 vs qjs 13/3.

acp__acp__tests__turns.note: Cancel-delivery latency, not an ordering bug: client.notify(session/cancel) resolves when the frame is WRITTEN; the qjs web-streams reader faces add dozens of microtask hops before the bridge processes it, while native streams deliver same-tick. The upstream assertions read the settlement flag synchronously after the await, so the admission trio (settled flag / agent-idle / a full LLM request in the gap) fails deterministically. Admission machinery itself verified correct (abort state, throwIfAborted, settlement latch). node 32/0 vs qjs 29/3.

session__session-telemetry-otel__tests__.note: qjs 0/4 (node 4/0). Probe-evidenced 2026-10-22: the OTLP dispatch DOES reach the loopback client face (four http.request calls to otel-direct.invalid, each with an agent and setTimeout(1000) armed — the missing setTimeout face was found and fixed this session), yet the in-test collector records zero captures. The failing hop is inside the agent-lookup routing from the dispatch to the collector server (host spelling otel-direct.invalid vs the registry key) or the exporter's swallowed response handling; needs its own instrumented dig.

lsp__lsp-stdio__tests__instance.note: One timing-sensitive test: 'terminates when abort interrupts a backpressured didOpen write' lands either side across identical runs (23/0 and 22/1 both observed 2026-10-22) — the abort-vs-backpressure write race under the shim stream faces. node 23/0 stable; the qjs instance suite is otherwise green.
